name: Block 1 — Heritage Block (Admin & Placements)
description: Central administration building, reception, and placement center.

name: Block 2 — Central Library & Information Centre
description: 5-story central library facility with group reading zones and digital center.

name: Blocks 3 & 4 — Automobile & Aeronautical Engineering
description: Aircraft hangar bay, flight simulation labs, and wind-tunnel facilities.

name: Blocks 5 & 6 — Mechanical Engineering & Heavy Workshops
description: Heavy machinery labs, lathe bays, IC engine labs, and mechatronics.

name: Block 7 — Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE)
description: Multi-story EEE building with specialized electronics and power labs.

name: Blocks 8, 9 & 10 — Biotechnology & Chemical Sciences
description: Bioprocess labs, plant tissue culture, and instrumentation hubs.

name: Blocks 13 & 14 — Architecture & Design Studios
description: Open drafting studios, model workshops, and thesis exhibition galleries.

name: Blocks 16 & 17 — Management Studies (MBA, MCA) & Telecom
description: Post-graduate lecture theaters, case study rooms, and microwave labs.

name: Block 19 & New Engineering Block — Computing Hub (CSE / ISE / AI / IoT)
description: Primary computing clusters, software labs, AI GPU nodes, and startup hub.

name: Premachandra Sagar Centre for Performing Arts (Auditorium)
description: 800-seat modern indoor auditorium adjacent to the central lawns.

name: Central Dining Hall & Campus Canteens
description: Multi-cuisine student dining hall and perimeter cafeteria outlets.

name: Gymnasium & Indoor Sports Arena
description: Fitness training center and indoor game facilities.

name: Main Entrance Gates (Gate 1 & Gate 2) & Security Desks
description: Main perimeter checkpoints and student security stations.

name: Two-Wheeler & Four-Wheeler Parking Zones
description: Dedicated parking lots across upper and lower campus tiers.
